A structured monthly cycle includes technical audit and fixes in week one, on-page optimisation and content publishing in weeks two and three, link building outreach running continuously, and a full reporting and strategy review in week four.

## Key Questions to Ask Prospects

1. **Do they do hands-on technical fixes monthly?** Ask for examples of specific fixes they've implemented.
2. **Is reporting tied to business outcomes?**
Clear reports should show what work was performed, what changed in rankings and traffic, and how those changes connect to actual business outcomes.

annotations.title: What Full-Service SEO Actually Includes in 2026 (and What's Missing From Most Proposals)

sections.text:
3. **What's included in their standard retainer?** Avoid agencies that treat schema implementation, entity optimization, or GBP management as premium add-ons.

The key differentiator is whether they're executing work or just monitoring—ask for a detailed breakdown of their monthly deliverables and request references from clients in your industry.
